ComplicationRoll.Label: Complication Roll
ComplicationRoll.Subtitle: 1dt Threat - 1dt Obstacle
ComplicationRoll.DropTooltip: Apply the stored complication and clear it.

LoadArrow.Description: Set a new arrow and draw the bowstring as an Impact action.
LoadArrow.Label: Load Arrow

QuickLoad.Description: Use a crossbow's quick-loader to span the string and ready the next bolt as a Setup action.
QuickLoad.Label: Quick Load

RaiseShield.Description: Raise a shield as a Setup action to gain Fortified 1.
RaiseShield.Label: Raise Shield

Shoot.Description: Make a ranged attack with Aim and Grace.
Shoot.Label: Shoot

Throw.Description: Hurl a weapon or object with Aim and Power.
Throw.Label: Throw

Brace.Description: Resist force, displacement, or control with Brace and Power.
Brace.Label: Brace

Break.Description: Reduce Bound, Exposed, or Pushed with Brace and Power.
Break.Label: Break

Evade.Description: Avoid an attack by moving clear with Evasion and Grace.
Evade.Label: Evade

Expose.Description: Open a gap in a foe's defense with Control and Grace, applying Exposed.
Expose.Label: Expose

Grapple.Description: Seize a foe within reach with Control and Power. [0] Pinned; [3] Grabbed.
Grapple.Label: Grapple

HoldTheLine.Description: Block the enemy's path. Until your next activation, you may draw melee attacks onto yourself but cannot Evade.
HoldTheLine.Label: Hold the Line

Grit.Description: Resist pain, poison, or physical hardship with raw toughness.
Grit.Label: Grit

Guard.Description: Catch or redirect an attack with Guard and Grace.
Guard.Label: Guard

Unleash.Description: Channel wildness and older powers. Add the lower of your current Favour and Reverence to your following Impact roll, then set Favour to 0.
Unleash.Label: Unleash

Focus.Description: Channel discipline and inner order. After your following Impact action, recover reserves equal to the lower of your current Favour and Virtue and distribute them freely before marking Strain triggered by that action. Then set Favour to 0.
Focus.Label: Focus

Push.Description: Drive a foe back with Strike and Power, applying Pushed.
Push.Label: Push

Resolve.Description: Resist fear, influence, or despair through mental resolve.
Resolve.Label: Resolve

SecurePassage.Description: Spend an Impact action to stabilize or clear a route so others can pass safely.
SecurePassage.Label: Secure Passage

Snap.Description: Answer a sudden threat with an immediate reflex.
Snap.Label: Snap

Strike.Description: Make a melee attack with Strike and Power.
Strike.Label: Strike

Switchgear.Description: Spend a Setup action to exchange held items with gear in Ready.
Switchgear.Label: Switchgear

TakeCover.Description: Move into available cover and gain Cover equal to the terrain modifier.
TakeCover.Label: Take Cover

TraverseHazard.Description: Cross a hazard safely with Athletics and Grace.
TraverseHazard.Label: Traverse Hazard

Arc.Description:
Strike a target with a short arc of energy. The target resists with Snap.
Effect: [1] Impaired +1; [4] Damage +1.
Arc.Label: Arc

Fireball.Description:
Manifest hot flame across an entire zone. The flames ignite only volatile material and otherwise go out immediately.
Effect: [1] Damage 1 +1/2.
Fireball.Label: Fireball

Glue.Description:
Create a small area of adhesive fluid.
Effect: [1] Impaired 1; [3] Pinned; [5] Grabbed.
Glue.Label: Glue

DancingLight.Description:
Create a floating light that follows you or a willing ally. For 1 additional Will, command it to follow another creature or move to a point within sight.
Duration: until the next Breather.
DancingLight.Label: Dancing Light

Prestidigitation.Description: Produce a small magical effect: sparks, a sharp report, a brief scent, a crude image, or a simple object. It is no more dangerous than a firecracker, convincing than a crayon drawing, or durable than modelling clay. Before casting, you may spend Will; the spell cannot create more successes than the Will spent. If no successes are required, it succeeds automatically.
Prestidigitation.Label: Prestidigitation

ProtectivePrayer.Description: Grant an ally Fortified for one round. Each Will spent increases Fortified by 1, up to your Tier. No free hand is required.
ProtectivePrayer.Label: Protective Prayer

Sanctify.Description: Cleanse a creature or object of dirt, foul odors, or wetness. A creature covered in a substance is freed of it. If touching the substance is hazardous, suffer its effect once before the cleansing takes hold. On a cursed target, the spell fails in an immediately noticeable way.
Sanctify.Label: Sanctify

RebukeEvil.Description:
Instill dread in all nearby beings with evil intent.
Effect: [0] Frightened 1 +1/2.
RebukeEvil.Label: Rebuke Evil

Blessing.Description: Allow each ally in a Near Zone to convert Favour into reserves as if using Focus.
Blessing.Label: Blessing

BountifulBloom.Description: Plants burst upward and bloom man-high, granting Cover 2 throughout the caster's zone. Depending on the environment and dominant flora, the growth may later be harvested for food or supplies.
BountifulBloom.Label: Bountiful Bloom

AllmothersFavour.Description: Grant 1 Favour to an ally in the caster's zone. Each Will spent increases the Favour granted by 1, up to your Tier.
AllmothersFavour.Label: Allmother's Favour

Position.Description: Changes stance, location, or placement on the battlefield.
Position.Label: Position

Setup.Description: Changes the following Impact action or the next round. Only one Setup action is available per activation, so Setup actions cannot be combined.
Setup.Label: Setup

Impaired.Label: Impaired
Impaired.Description: The target takes a penalty equal to the effect's value on all Action rolls. Grit, Snap, and Resolve are unaffected.

Exposed.Label: Exposed
Exposed.Description: The target takes a penalty equal to the effect's value on Guard and Evade.

Bound.Label: Bound
Bound.Description: The target takes a penalty equal to the effect's value on Strike and Guard.

Pushed.Label: Pushed
Pushed.Description: The target takes a penalty equal to the effect's value on Brace and Guard.

Frightened.Label: Frightened
Frightened.Description: The target takes a penalty equal to the effect's value on Strike and Control.

Pinned.Label: Pinned
Pinned.Description: The target cannot take Position actions. This prevents regular movement, taking cover, intercepting, and similar positioning maneuvers. The target can still move by spending another action; Secure Passage remains available because it is an Impact action.

Grabbed.Label: Grabbed
Grabbed.Description: The target cannot take Position actions or use any other form of its own movement or positioning.

Fortified.Label: Fortified
Fortified.Description: The target gains a bonus equal to the effect's value on Brace, Guard, and Evade.

Cover.Label: Cover
Cover.Description: The target gains a bonus equal to the effect's value on Evasion.

HP.Description: How much damage the character can take before it affects their behavior in combat.
HP.Label: Hitpoints

Wounds.Description: How many states the NPC can go through before they are brought down.
Wounds.Label: Wounds

Will.Description: Focus, intent, mental pressure, and assertion.
Will.Label: Will

Grit.Description: Bodily toughness against pain, poison, and the elements.
Grit.Label: Grit

Resolve.Description: Mental resilience to fear, influence, or despair.
Resolve.Label: Resolve

Snap.Description: Instant reflex response to sudden threats.
Snap.Label: Snap

Academia.Description: Recall scholarly knowledge and analyze complex subjects.
Academia.Label: Academia

Alter.Description: Transform matter, bodies, or physical states.
Alter.Label: Alter

Athletics.Description: Perform physical feats of strength, speed, or motion.
Athletics.Label: Athletics

Brace.Description: Absorb force and stand firm against impact.
Brace.Label: Brace

Compel.Description: Impose force on minds, spirits, or entities.
Compel.Label: Compel

Control.Description: Manipulate positioning, balance, or leverage in melee.
Control.Label: Control

Craft.Description: Build, repair, or create functional equipment or tools.
Craft.Label: Craft

Evasion.Description: Evade attacks through agility and trained movement.
Evasion.Label: Evasion

Folklore.Description: Recall local tales, legends, traditions, and the links between them.
Folklore.Label: Folklore

Guard.Description: Parry or deflect incoming attacks with technique.
Guard.Label: Guard

HandleBeasts.Description: Handle mounts and animals; calm or direct creatures.
HandleBeasts.Label: Handle Beasts

Impress.Description: Shape how others perceive you through presence or display.
Impress.Label: Impress

Influence.Description: Shift another’s intentions through persuasion or pressure.
Influence.Label: Influence

Insight.Description: Read motives, patterns, and emotional cues.
Insight.Label: Insight

Manifest.Description: Create or project raw magical force.
Manifest.Label: Manifest

Navigate.Description: Chart routes, orient yourself, and read terrain or maps.
Navigate.Label: Navigate

Notice.Description: Spot details, changes, or hidden elements in the environment.
Notice.Label: Notice

Reveal.Description: Expose truth, detect hidden things, or gain insight.
Reveal.Label: Reveal

Ward.Description: Protect or cleanse targets through magical safeguards.
Ward.Label: Ward

Stealth.Description: Avoid detection through silence, concealment, or timing.
Stealth.Label: Stealth

Track.Description: Follow trails, signs, and environmental disturbances.
Track.Label: Track

Transpose.Description: Shift positions, move objects, or bend states and space.
Transpose.Label: Transpose

Virtue.Description: Discipline, constancy, self-control, moral resolve, and civilized order.
Virtue.Label: Virtue

Reverence.Description: Awe, boundaries, taboos, protection, older powers, nature, spirits, and places.
Reverence.Label: Reverence

Vice.Description: Infernal corruption through temptation, self-justification, entanglement, guilt, bargains, status, possessions, relationships, reputation, and dependence.
Vice.Label: Vice

Ruin.Description: Abyssal corruption through destruction, desecration, hunger, dissolution, mutation, loss of control, and damnation.
Ruin.Label: Ruin

Blackmagic.Description: Spend 1 Power to fold life force into a manifestation and gain +2 Manifest.
Blackmagic.Label: Blackmagic

Stormcaller.Description: Spend 1 Will to bind storm energy to a lightning spell and gain +2 to its roll.
Stormcaller.Label: Stormcaller

Emanation.Description: Spend 1 Will to affect all valid targets in a zone, allies and enemies alike. Resolve the effect at only one degree of success.
Emanation.Label: Emanation

BreakStance.Description: Spend 1 Power to reduce a status effect by 1 per success.
BreakStance.Label: Break Stance

Counterguard.Description: Spend 1 Grace to gain +2 Guard with the weapon's leverage.
Counterguard.Label: Counterguard

Drag.Description: Spend 1 Grace to gain +1 Push and pull the target toward you instead of driving it away.
Drag.Label: Drag

Deny.Description: Spend 1 Grace. On a successful Guard, the first success applies Bound 1.
Deny.Label: Deny

Intercept.Description: Spend 2 Grace. On a successful Guard, the first success applies Bound 1.
Intercept.Label: Intercept

PrecisionThrust.Description: Spend 1 Grace to gain +2 Strike with a precise thrust.
PrecisionThrust.Label: Precision Thrust

Quickshot.Description: Spend 1 Grace to load and shoot in one motion, even when the weapon begins unloaded.
Quickshot.Label: Quickshot

PushThrough.Description: Spend 1 Power to gain +2 Push and drive the target farther back.
PushThrough.Label: Push Through

ShieldCover.Description: Spend 1 Grace to gain +2 Evasion behind the shield.
ShieldCover.Label: Shield Cover

ShieldBrace.Description: Spend 2 Power to brace behind the shield against heavy attacks.
ShieldBrace.Label: Shield Brace

WardingRunes.Description: Spend 1 Will to gain +1 on a Resistance roll through protective runes.
WardingRunes.Label: Warding Runes

ShieldPull.Description: Spend 1 Grace to gain +2 Expose by opening an opponent's shield or cover.
ShieldPull.Label: Shield Pull

TrippingHook.Description: Spend 1 Grace to gain +2 Expose by catching a foe with a hooked weapon.
TrippingHook.Label: Tripping Hook

Consumable.Description: Consumable items used up on use.
Consumable.Label: Consumable

Held.Description: Items that must be held in hand to function.
Held.Label: Held

Worn.Description: Items that are worn on the body.
Worn.Label: Worn

Camp.Description: Gear stored at camp and not carried on an expedition.
Camp.Label: Camp

Dropped.Description: Gear on the ground and not ready for use.
Dropped.Label: Dropped

Hand.Description: Gear held in either of the character's 2 hands and immediately usable. Hands cannot be overloaded.
Hand.Label: Hands

Pack.Description: Gear stored in the Backpack, with capacity equal to Power. Drop the Backpack, then spend an Impact action to access it. It can be overloaded.
Pack.Label: Backpack

Ready.Description: Up to 10 PL of gear carried within easy reach. Accessing it costs a Setup action. Ready cannot be overloaded.
Ready.Label: Ready

Worn.Description: Clothing and armor worn on the body, with capacity equal to Power. Worn can be overloaded.
Worn.Label: Worn

SpellPreparation.Label: Preparation state

Prepared.Label: Prepared
Prepared.Description: Prepared spells are active; their Complexity counts against Will. The selection normally changes only in camp.

Ritual.Label: Ritual
Ritual.Description: Ritual spells are known for ritual use but inactive as regular actions. Their total Complexity is not limited.

Untrained.Label: Untrained
Untrained.Description: Untrained spells are not yet available and do not count against preparation limits.

SpellPreparation.InvalidDrop: Invalid preparation state for this spell.
